_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Check AI crawler access in robots.txt...

description: Checks whether 14 AI crawlers may fetch a page. Use it when the user asks whether AI crawlers can read a website or page, for example "can AI crawlers read example.com?", "is GPTBot blocked in my robots.txt?" or "which AI bots are allowed on https://example.com/blog?". Pass the page address. Returns, for 14 AI crawlers, whether robots.txt allows the page and the rule that decided it, plus the sitemaps, the redirect chain, and the page's X-Robots-Tag header and robots meta tag. It reads robots.txt only and does not test whether a firewall blocks crawlers. Do not use it for private or local addresses, for security scans, or to collect a site's content.

url.description: Address of a public web page, for example https://example.com/pricing. A bare domain such as example.com means https. Only public http and https sites on the standard ports are checked.

name: check_ai_crawler_access

blockedCrawlers.description: Tokens of the crawlers robots.txt blocks on this page.

allowed.description: Whether robots.txt allows this crawler on the page. null means robots.txt could not be read, so there is no verdict.

purpose.description: What the crawler collects for, such as training or search.

rule.description: The robots.txt line that decided it, such as Disallow: /.

failure.description: Why the page was not reached or read, such as a timeout or a refused redirect.

finalUrl.description: Address of the final page after redirects.

notes.description: Plain-language caveats to pass on with the result.

notice.description: As-of caveat: what the site sent to Agent Tools at that moment, not what every crawler sees.

reachable.description: False when no page answered; failure then says why.

redirects.description: Redirect chain from the address to the page.

location.description: Location header of a redirect hop: where it points next.

status.description: HTTP status code of this hop, such as 301 or 200.
found: rules were read. missing: a 4xx answer, so nothing is restricted. unreachable: a 5xx, no answer, or a web page instead of a robots file, so there is no verdict.

source.description: Where the data came from: the website itself.

status.description: HTTP status code of the final page.

url.description: The address checked, after a bare domain became https.

title: Check AI crawler access in robots.txt
